decisions.text: The oversold orders are cancelled with a voucher
decisions.quote: We'll cancel them with a voucher. I'll decide the amount with marketing today.

decisions.text: Marcus does not rewrite the ERP connector before Thursday; the rewrite waits until after the promo season
decisions.quote: Okay, scrap the rewrite, I won't rewrite the connector before Thursday.

decisions.text: Rate limit on the connector's API key is set at 150 requests per second
decisions.quote: I'd set the limit at a hundred and fifty.

decisions.text: A low-stock buffer is used for promo products, better to show "sold out" than oversell
decisions.quote: For promo products, that's fine. Better to say "sold out" than to sell something we don't have.

decisions.text: No dedicated engineer for Harbor Lane; escalation number and an on-call brief instead
decisions.quote: Rachel, honestly, no, not as a permanent arrangement.

decisions.text: Weekly Monday call with Harbor Lane until the end of January
decisions.quote: Then I'll set up a weekly Monday call with your team until the end of January, starting next Monday.

decisions.text: We do not cover the vouchers Harbor Lane gave to customers
decisions.quote: Rachel, I'm sorry, but we can't cover the vouchers directly.

decisions.text: No goodwill refund of all promo orders, only the duplicate charges are refunded
decisions.quote: I want to be straight with you: we can't do that.

decisions.text: Promo prices are pushed the evening before, so only stock changes during the Black Friday peak
decisions.quote: We usually push the promo prices at six in the morning, an hour before. We can do it the evening before.

decisions.text: The Black Friday email goes out in waves instead of all at once
decisions.quote: Okay. Waves it is. It's really not optional anymore, is it.
